known_falsification: CAP02 source 99721/99739 evidence key posterior underperformed full matched Bayesian control and even ungated mixture on both. Do not retune or score as novel.
hypothesis: Native matched intervention contrasts from witnessed branch-reset counterfactual forks may form an action effect representation that generalizes across public states better than pooled/fitted controls, while preserving old native memories during cumulative learning.

source.start: exact last public post from sealed per-OS CAP02 1086/1061 trained checkpoint
source.actions: at every public state, precommit all four (a,b) interventions, execute each from same synthetic frozen state, witness all four causal consequences, and follow one precommitted primary branch to next state; never treat the other three as sequential native events
source.family: two independent deterministic causal equations; actions not retrofitted to results
source.hidden: latent and phase evaluator-only; never inputs

model.original: cold restore entire CAP02 seven-component 1086/1061 cumulative native plus all six heads, source verified; preserve prior prefix and immutable native archive
model.native: only precommitted primary branch of each episode updates native and six heads once, 32 total new episodes each seed
model.contrast: additional native causal-contrast representation uses paired effects against (a=0,b=0) anchor for each public 3-bit state; separate frozen original, per-state anchor Beta and globally learned arm deltas; no LLM/no tokens
model.controls: Bayesian exact state/arm full-history counts, Beta pooled action across states, fully refitted regularized 16-feature linear ridge model on exact same witnessed four fork labels each step, unpaired/shuffled contrast ablation, frozen original native and continuous native descriptive readouts
model.forecast_clock: score every fork action before exposing any of its outcomes, then update all contrast and conventional arms once, update seven-component native only on the precommitted chosen branch
model.protection: exclude all private state/phase/seed from predictors; preserve original source checkpoint bytes and old historical readout exactly
model.cold: roundtrip original and new causal contrast with witnessed-fork tape canonical SHA; fail closed on altered source IDs, different effects, event count and action schedule

qualifier.primary: prequential mean two-output Brier on all 4 action forks over the final 10 A-return steps, separately per source seed; lower better
qualifier.development_go: paired native contrast beats the STRONGEST of exact-state Beta, pooled-arm Beta, fully fitted 16-feature ridge, and shuffled-contrast negative by at least 0.005 Brier on BOTH seeds, with post-training original immutable native/JEPA readout byte-exact and cold evidence audit PASS
qualifier.secondary: action ranking correctness vs held branch outcomes, conditional effect absolute error, resource timings; descriptive, not automatic pass
qualifier.stopping: score once per original frozen development source per OS, both are replicas not independent new scientific populations, no after-result tuning on these seeds; FAIL/NO_GO if any primary condition fails
